posts.caption: Yall mind if I get a little niche (surface Black Library lore) and yes in my headcanon Loken somehow survives and became an OG grey knight #warhammer40k #warhammer #hobby #40k #warhammer30k
posts.label: other
posts.worked: A 7-second hot take on Black Library lore reached 245,869 views (47.5x the median) with 18,662 likes, the strongest result in the window, and it was short enough to finish.
posts.didnt: Its appeal depends on Black Library knowledge, which breaks the rule that posts must read for a non-player, so it may not convert followers as well as the reach suggests.
posts.next_time: Keep the "headcanon" framing as a fan's opinion and not a lore claim, and on the next lore-adjacent post show a lit mini or a reaction in second one so a non-player still gets the joke.

posts.caption: I love the 3 hours per week I can paint (if I’m lucky) #warhammer40k #warhammer #hobby #40k #painting
posts.label: meme
posts.worked: A joke about his own hobby life ("3 hours per week I can paint") at 8 seconds reached 116,903 views (22.6x median) with a 6.6% engagement rate, the kind of self-joke the brief says converts reach into a reason to follow.
posts.didnt: Nothing obvious; the caption is a single line and the payoff was not something the caption could carry, so the rest depends on the visual.
posts.next_time: Repost it in about 48 hours with a new caption (for example, a different hour count) and pair the joke with a lit painting shot in second one to see whether the second roll holds.

posts.caption: My airbrush frightens me #warhammer40k #warhammer #hobby #40k #relationships
posts.label: meme
posts.worked: "My airbrush frightens me" is a self-joke about his own hobby that a non-player can read, at 15.2 seconds with original audio, and it reached 106,018 views (20.5x median) with 82 comments.
posts.didnt: At 15 seconds it is near the top of the length range, and the comment count is modest for its reach, so the opener may be carrying the result more than the joke.
posts.next_time: Check the opener: if the airbrush or the frightened reaction lands in second one, keep the length; if not, cut to about 8 seconds with the joke on screen and the story in the caption.

posts.caption: With this week’s 20 minutes of hobby time I finally did a bit of painting on this 3d printed blown up baneblade I’ve had sitting around for ages! What’s a project you’ve had sitting around begging for paint? #warhammer40
posts.label: story
posts.worked: A genuine painting update on a big 3D-printed Baneblade shows real craft, and the closing question invites comments.
posts.didnt: At 58.4 seconds with a caption that opens on a progress report ("With this week's 20 minutes of hobby time"), it hits the exact failure pattern: long, build-log opener, and no payoff early. It reached 511 views (0.1x median) with 0 comments, and it used non-original audio.
posts.next_time: Cut to about 20 seconds, open on the finished Baneblade or its headlights in second one, put a joke on screen, and move the story and the question into the caption.

posts.caption: Somebody though they could sneak around and not get caught 🙄 #warhammer40k #warhammer #hobby #40k #alphalegion
posts.label: meme
posts.worked: A short 13-second Alpha Legion joke is a light, quick format that can reach non-players.
posts.didnt: The joke ("sneak around and not get caught") is generic and does not involve his minis or his Guard army, so it gave viewers no reason to follow. It had 1,025 views (0.2x median), 0 comments, and non-original audio.
posts.next_time: Keep the format but swap the joke for one about his own Guard: a Guardsman sneaking past the camera with his own audio, a hard cut at the end, and no insider lore needed.

posts.caption: Funny noticing all of the parts I left unpainted now that I look at it under a camera 😬😬 #warhammer40k #warhammer #hobby #40k #paintingwarhammer
posts.label: meme
posts.worked: The caption's joke is about his own minis (noticing the unpainted parts under the camera), which is the kind of self-directed joke that can build follows.
posts.didnt: At 26.7 seconds with non-original audio, the post reached only 1,216 views (0.2x median) with 5 comments. Likely cause: the reveal of the unpainted parts is not early in the clip, so the first seconds don't pay off. Check the opener.
posts.next_time: Open on the macro camera shot of the unpainted gap in second one, keep it under 15 seconds, and use original audio.

patterns: Self-jokes about his own hobby life drove the top reach: "3 hours per week I can paint" (116,903 views, 22.6x median) and "My airbrush frightens me" (106,018 views, 20.5x median) both outperformed generic memes, which stayed under 1,300 views in the weakest set.

All three weakest posts used non-original audio (511, 1,025 and 1,216 views, 0.1x to 0.2x median), while two of the three strongest used original audio. This is a window-level pattern with few posts, so keep testing it rather than treating it as settled.

Length and caption framing separated the results: the winners were 7 to 15 seconds with a joke or hook in the caption, while the weakest story post was 58 seconds and opened on a progress update, so long build logs keep failing the same way they did in the audit.
